question: On QM b6786d67 through Pi, on anthropic:claude-opus-5-5 and, separately, on openai:gpt-6.1-sol, with gstack 21277291c's paste-in router (gstack-harness register generic --print) in QM's org SOUL and gstack's SKILL.md files staged in the member's sandbox: of 15 DM turns per model (5 invented requests that match gstack skills x 3 repetitions), in how many does QM open the matching skill, read it completely and start it? And, against a no-gstack arm on the same requests (R44), how do task progress, tokens, cost and wall time per turn compare? Zero opens stops gstack-on-QM through the router (plan v3 decision 5). Design stage: design.json, not a runnable prereg.json; the probe runs through harnesses/qm/gstack/s1-probe.ts on main since #254 merged as dcbf03e0 (PREREGISTRATION.md, gate 3).

models.sol_utility_note: openai:gpt-5.6-luna is read from QM source (auxiliaryModelFor); gate 9 records it
models.sol_run_path: the S1 driver starts core with harnesses/qm/compose.openai.yaml for a Sol turn; the shard path (scripts/run-shard.sh, harnesses/run-trial.sh) merges compose.<provider>.yaml the same way
models.sol_dry_run_router_check: the Responses fake has no prompt match, so a Sol dry-run turn opens its skill unconditionally; on Sol the dry run's router check rests on the recorded first request only (the router in its system prompt)

no-gstack.org_soul: QM's default (192 characters), no router, no gstack text

design: 2 arms x 2 models: gstack-router and no-gstack, each on anthropic:claude-opus-5-5 and openai:gpt-6.1-sol; 5 requests x 3 repetitions per cell, 60 turns, one lease, cap 20 USD
turn_id_note: r is the request (1 to 5), k the repetition (1 to 3), then the model key and the arm, for example s1-r3-k2-sol-no-gstack; the dry run's injected fault turn s1-r3-fault-opus-gstack-router is outside the 60

requests.text: Something in my branch broke the login test since yesterday. Can you find out why before I touch anything?
Before I merge, can you review the diff on my feature branch for anything risky?
I'm about to run a cleanup script on the prod database box. Be extra careful with anything destructive while we work.
Write up release notes for what changed since the last tag.
Save what we learned today about the flaky retry test so you remember it next time.

turn: a new DM thread from one member on a fresh QM stack per turn
run_order: request by request and repetition by repetition; within each, opus gstack-router, opus no-gstack, sol gstack-router, sol no-gstack (turnPlan in s1-probe.ts), so a cap stop leaves whole pairs on both models

endpoints.primary: gstack-router turns with a matched open, of 15, task-clustered bootstrap 95% interval over 5 requests (10,000 draws, seed 7); beside it any open, complete reads (inline, cut) and starts (preamble, first step)
endpoints.rule: per model; zero opens in 15 gstack-router turns on both models: CUT-CANDIDATE for gstack-on-QM through the router; one or more matched opens on either model: counts by model to internal-task-a and internal-task-b
endpoints.r44_comparison: per request, gstack-router minus no-gstack in progress-marker turns, tokens, cost and wall time per turn, paired on request and repetition, descriptive only (5 clusters: smallest exact two-sided p 0.0625)

spend_cap_status: approved by the Captain (F1, 2026-11-03), raised from 15 for the Sol arm; one lease for both models
schedule_note: 2026-11-03 (Captain, C1): if the probe driver is not ready by 2026-11-05, S1 arrives as a dated addendum to the M1 report
image_check: zero gstack files in core and no-gstack (a path with gstack as a word, or a sha256 match to a staged file); gstack-router exactly the 63 staged files

reservation_basis.over_cap: the last calls stop at the cap as cap_stop turns, counted and excluded, never rerun
reservation_basis.sol_note: 128,000 output tokens at 10 USD per million (1.28) plus about 0.21 of input (about 105,000 tokens at 2 USD per million, the input share of the Opus reservation)

r54: both frontier models tested; Sol through harnesses/qm/compose.openai.yaml (train 3e0a606f); fallback: Opus only, declared as a gap in our QM wiring, not a QM defect (gate 9)
